messages:
Elena: Quick heads-up — proposing we unpin runtime v2.14 and SDK 1.5 from hosted canary next Tue 2026-03-24 09:00 UTC. Reason: kernel + batching fixes resolve the quant long-seq regression. Need OK from releases + oncall and a fallback plan.

Mike: +1 for unpin but we should gate on 48h of canary telemetry. last time 6h was not enough.

Sarah: oncall here. Can we add a fallback route to runtime-v2.13 in case latency or error rate spikes >3x baseline for 2 consecutive 5m windows? :eyes:

DeployBot: Automated check: compatible_models.yml -> found potential incompatibility: llama3q-8k (quantized) flagged for kvcache mismatch. Marking as DEPENDS_ON_MANUAL_VERIFICATION :warning:

Jason: I can take the llama3q verification. Will run end-to-end smoke and long-seq synthetic tests tonight. ETA 18:00 UTC.

Elena: thanks. also update release notes to call out known caveat with quantized llama3q and to include explicit rollback commands. I'll draft the blurb.

Priya: question — does the unpin change routing for Dedicated customers pinned at runtime v2.13? We should not auto-upgrade dedicated pools.

Mike: correct — dedicated remains pinned. Hosted only. add a note for Dedicated/Private in release notes.

Jason: quick test update: llama3q long-seq passed 50k tokens synthetic on v2.14 but KV cache warmup behaviour differs for seq > 4k. There's a small transient latency bump (~40ms) for first 5 tokens after a cache miss.

Sarah: acceptable if it doesn't cause tail latency SLO violations. oncall will watch traces; can we add an automated alert threshold for 95th pct increase >25ms during canary window?

Elena: yes — add alert rule and a playbook snippet that runs the rollback command:
```bash
# rollback runtime on hosted canary pool
deploybot rollback runtime --pool canary-hosted --to-version v2.13 --reason "post-unpin spike"
```

DeployBot: Preflight action: scheduled canary unpin at 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z. Preconditions:
- canary flag set to true
- telemetry gating enabled
- model manual verification required cleared by Jason

Jason: manual verification complete — llama3q kvcache ok with the mitigation (staggered warmup). I uploaded test logs: https://artifacts/internal/llama3q-unpin-logs

Mike: final checklist from eng-releases perspective:
- [x] QA smoke
- [x] Compatibility tests
- [x] Release notes updated
- [x] Rollback commands in playbook
- [x] Alerting configured
- [ ] Post-unpin ramp template (suggest 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 3h)

Elena: let's do 10/30/60 over 3h rather than 10/50/100 — reduces burst risk.

Sarah: agreed. oncall will monitor and we have automatic rollback if error/latency thresholds hit.

DeployBot: Action taken: applied staged unpin schedule to hosted canary pool: 10% -> 30% -> 60% with 1h waits. Job id: jb-20260324-09-unpin-001

Priya: can you also add a note for customers using custom quant profiles? Some may need to recompile kernels; contact support-team@redwood.com if they see regressions.

Elena: done. I'll kick the announcement and publish release notes after first ramp step completes. Thanks team :rocket:

Oncall-bot: Reminder: if rollback triggered, please ping #incidents and attach `jb-20260324-09-unpin-001` to the incident ticket.

Mike: shepherding postmortem template in case rollback occurs. Let's reconvene after 6h of canary stable, or immediately if alerts fire.
